import os,json,urllib.request,urllib.error,pathlib
ROOT=pathlib.Path(__file__).parent
BASE=os.environ['MCPJAM_API_URL'].rstrip('/')
def api(path,body=None,save=None):
 req=urllib.request.Request(BASE+path,data=None if body is None else json.dumps(body).encode(),headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+os.environ['MCPJAM_API_KEY'],'Content-Type':'application/json'})
 try:
  with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=30) as r: status,data=r.status,json.load(r)
 except urllib.error.HTTPError as e: status,data=e.code,json.loads(e.read())
 if save: (ROOT/save).write_text(json.dumps({'httpStatus':status,'request':{'path':path,'body':body},'response':data},indent=2)+'\\n')
 print(path,status,json.dumps(data))
 return status,data
if __name__=='__main__':
 p='/projects/project_fixture/servers/server_fixture'
 api(p+'/doctor',{},'doctor.json')
